text: Plan about 1,200 MiB for the steady state. The Memory Sizing page gives steady memory as 186 MiB + 7 KB per loaded chunk + twice the largest index. Here: 186 MiB base (37 MiB for Python, the SDK and a MossClient, plus 149 MiB for the embedding model); 300 x 500 = 150,000 chunks x 7 KB ≈ 1,001 MiB; largest index 500 chunks x 7 KB ≈ 3.3 MiB, twice that ≈ 7 MiB. Total ≈ 1,194 MiB. Add your application's own memory on top, and the one-time model-load peak of about 380 MiB plus the indexes loading alongside it applies only at startup.
